item.text:
The F27 negative result held up under a stronger control. I re-ran the naive sub-case 4 guard on top of the validated F12/F17 TryPreAccept conflict fixes (`diagnostic_fix16/`). The focused F27 and F12/F17 tests pass, but the 500-seed campaign is still **321 pass / 85 SKIP / 94 NOOP / 0 divergence** ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix16_campaign500_output.txt)).

So the 85 lost proposals are caused by the inferred sub-case 4 guard/threshold itself, not merely by the TryPreAccept conflict-table defects. The correct guard remains unresolved pending the TLA/upstream reference; no fix is recommended from this experiment.

The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing cluster controls**. The captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly. This negative validation is recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md), [validation_matrix.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), [remediation.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/remediation.md), and [handoff_check.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/handoff_check.txt).
